name: PX_plan
frozen_before: any recorded full day was read (recorder started 2026-11-27 19:35 UTC; only its first minutes' lag log and a 3-minute 11-27 sample were looked at, for P0 latency and test fixtures)

data.markets: top 150 mapped Pascal markets by Pascal 24h taker notional, list refreshed every 6 h
data.trades: Pascal trades with both wallets; PM last_trade_price

views.pascal: state_time_ms + that day's median (recv - state_time_ms) (about 7 ms on 11-27)

orders.pascal: enters the first 50 ms round starting at or after send + 2 ms (rounds on multiples of 50 ms); matches against the book published after that round (last row with state_time < round + 50 ms): that round's cancels and earlier orders go first; walks the recorded 3 levels
orders.polymarket: matches at send + 430 ms (sensitivity: 1000 ms) strictly against the displayed top 3 at that exchange time
orders.fill_known: Pascal: round + 50 ms + Pascal lag; Polymarket: match time + 116 ms

fees.pascal: per-market taker_fee_rate * p * (1 - p) (MarketSpec; default 0.02); maker rebate = rebate_share of the taker fee, own column, not counted in P&L
fees.polymarket: Gamma feeSchedule.rate * p * (1 - p) when feesEnabled, else 0 (matches CLOB fd.r on every category checked 11-27); taker only

PX-A.trigger: pair (Pascal outcome + its complement on Polymarket) costs < 1 - X after both taker fees, with >= $25 displayed at the top level of each leg
PX-A.size: min(top-level sizes, floor($200 / pair cost)) shares
PX-A.limits: seen ask + 1¢ (Pascal short: cost 1 - bid, i.e. bid - 1¢)
PX-A.second_leg: sent when the first leg's fill is known, for the filled quantity
PX-A.unwind: excess first-leg shares sold at the bid after the same latency, fee charged (beyond 3 levels: 3rd level - 5¢)
PX-A.cooldown: one attempt per market per 60 s

PX-B.quote: both sides on Pascal at Polymarket long mid (as seen) -/+ h, rounded to the Pascal tick away from the mid, post-only (a side that would cross when posted is skipped), $50 per side
PX-B.pull_requote: when the Polymarket mid seen moves >= 1¢ from the quoted mid; the cancel/replace lands in the first round starting >= PM exchange time + 116 + 2 ms
PX-B.fills: only from recorded Pascal taker trades while the quote is live; improving the displayed best: a trade at our price or worse for the taker fills up to its size; joining or behind: only trades through our price; fill at our price; no re-post within a quote epoch after a fill
PX-B.hedge: each fill bought as a Polymarket taker (complement) at fill time + Pascal lag + 430 ms, walking the top 3 (beyond: 3rd level + 1¢)
PX-B.rebate: own column; the rule must pass without it

PX-C.rule: buy every outcome of a Pascal is_mece event when the sum of asks + taker fees < 1 - X, >= $25 displayed per leg, all legs in one round, excess unwound at the bid

cells: 4 X x 3 leg orders (PX-A) + 3 h (PX-B) + 3 X (PX-C) = 18 cells, Polymarket latency 430 ms; 1000 ms reported as a sensitivity only
primary_set: markets whose expected resolution is within 30 days of the attempt; sports markets excluded from expected_event_start_time to +4 h (in play); in-play reported separately (--set inplay)

splits.day_definition: UTC day of the recorder's hourly files (receive time)
splits.note: dev = the first 3 full recorded UTC days; holdout = the next 7 full days, read once

pick: on dev: the cell with the highest 90% lower bound (min of market-bootstrap and day-bootstrap 5th percentile of sum(pnl)/sum(attempted shares)) among cells with >= 10 attempts/day; written to frozen/PX_pick.json and pushed before the holdout is opened. If no cell has >= 10 attempts/day: no pick, PX is written up as closed on dev.

pass.lb_method: bootstrap by market and by day, report the wider (lower) bound
pass.size: displayed size capped at $200 per attempt

commands.cache: cd ~/pascal-lighter && systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=1500M -p CPUQuota=60% nice -n 19 ~/shadow-venv/bin/python pascal/px_replay.py cache <DAY> [<DAY> ...]
commands.dev: cd ~/pascal-lighter && systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=1500M -p CPUQuota=60% nice -n 19 ~/shadow-venv/bin/python pascal/px_replay.py run 2026-11-28 2026-11-29 2026-11-30 --tag dev
commands.holdout: cd ~/pascal-lighter && systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=1500M -p CPUQuota=60% nice -n 19 ~/shadow-venv/bin/python pascal/px_replay.py run 2026-12-01 2026-12-02 2026-12-03 2026-12-04 2026-12-05 2026-12-06 2026-12-07 --tag holdout

earliest.holdout: after 2026-12-08 00:05 UTC and after frozen/PX_pick.json is pushed

synthetic_checks: pascal/tests/test_px_replay.py: flat books -> no attempts; planted 3¢ gap for 5 s -> +3.0¢/share on every leg order; planted 100 ms gap on the Polymarket side -> no profit (Pascal-first/together unwind at a loss, PM-first never fills); planted 100 ms gap on the Pascal side -> Pascal-first profits (Pascal is 2 ms away), PM-first loses; PX-B fill rule (joining: only through-price trades fill)
